# Dayjoy FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions

This is a sample markdown document used by the RAG integration test
suite. It uses standard markdown headings, bullet lists, and tables
so the chunking pipeline's markdown-aware splitter can be exercised.

---

## 1. Order Management

### How do I place an order?

Customers can place an order through the Dayjoy website, the mobile
app, or the WhatsApp AI assistant. Distributors can place orders
through the distributor portal or the distributor mobile app.

To place an order via the website:

1. Browse the catalogue and add products to the cart.
2. Proceed to checkout.
3. Enter the shipping address and contact number.
4. Choose a payment method (UPI, credit/debit card, net banking, or
   cash on delivery).
5. Confirm the order. An order confirmation is sent via email and
   WhatsApp within 2 minutes.

### What is the delivery timeline?

Orders are dispatched within 24 hours of confirmation. Standard
delivery takes 3–5 business days in metro cities and 5–7 business days
in other locations. Express delivery (next-day) is available in select
pin codes for an additional fee of Rs. 99.

### How do I track my order?

Once an order is dispatched, a tracking link is shared via SMS and
WhatsApp. Customers can also track orders in real time from the
"Orders" section of the mobile app.

## 2. Returns and Refunds

### What is the return policy?

Dayjoy offers a 7-day return policy on unopened products. To initiate
a return, the customer must raise a return request from the order
details page. A pickup is scheduled within 48 hours, and the refund is
processed to the original payment method within 5–7 business days of
the product being received back at the warehouse.

### When will I get my refund?

| Payment Method | Refund Timeline |
|----------------|-----------------|
| UPI            | 2–3 business days |
| Credit/Debit card | 5–7 business days |
| Net banking    | 5–7 business days |
| Cash on delivery | 7–10 business days (to bank account) |

Refunds are only initiated after the returned product has been
inspected at the warehouse. The customer is notified by email and
WhatsApp once the refund is initiated.

## 3. Product Information

### What are the side effects of Dayjoy Premium Health Tonic?

The Dayjoy Premium Health Tonic is made from natural Ayurvedic herbs
and is generally well-tolerated. In rare cases, mild gastrointestinal
discomfort may occur in the first few days of use. If you experience
any persistent side effects, discontinue use and consult a healthcare
professional.

### Is Dayjoy Premium Health Tonic safe for children?

The tonic is recommended for adults aged 18 years and above. For
children, consult a paediatrician before use. The recommended dosage
for children (if approved by a doctor) is 5 ml once daily after meals.

### Can pregnant or lactating women take this tonic?

Pregnant and lactating women should consult their doctor before
consuming any Ayurvedic preparation, including Dayjoy Premium Health
Tonic.

## 4. Distributor Queries

### How do I check my commission?

Distributors can view their commission statement for any month from
the "Earnings" section of the distributor mobile app. The statement
breaks down retail profit, performance bonus, and leadership bonus,
and shows the total amount credited to the registered bank account.

### What if my commission is delayed?

Commissions are credited on the 10th of every month. If you have not
received your commission by the 15th, please raise a ticket through
the distributor portal or contact your area sales manager. Common
causes of delay include pending KYC verification or incorrect bank
account details.

---

## 5. Account and Security

### How do I reset my password?

Customers and distributors can reset their password from the login
page by clicking "Forgot password". A one-time password (OTP) is sent
to the registered mobile number. After OTP verification, a new
password can be set.

### How do I enable two-factor authentication (2FA)?

Two-factor authentication can be enabled from the "Security" section
of the account settings page. Dayjoy supports SMS-based OTP and
authenticator-app-based 2FA. We strongly recommend enabling 2FA for
all accounts.
